{"content": "from typing import List

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict


class Ticket(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(str_strip_whitespace=True)

    ticket_id: str
    title: str
    assignee_id: str


def from_db_rows(rows: List[tuple]) -> List[Ticket]:
    # The database driver returns integer primary keys. Pydantic v2 does not
    # coerce int -> str in lax mode (v1 did), so convert explicitly.
    return [Ticket(ticket_id=str(r[0]), title=r[1], assignee_id=r[2]) for r in rows]


def by_assignee(tickets: List[Ticket], assignee: str) -> List[str]:
    return [t.ticket_id for t in tickets if t.assignee_id == assignee]
"}
